nf16e01.title: Do I bring them home this year?
nf16e01.caption: Not sure whether to bring them home this year? Ask them first. It's their holiday too, and a plan you make together beats one you guess at alone.

nf16e02.title: You're meeting their whole family.
nf16e02.caption: Meeting a whole family at once can feel like a test. It isn't. Be kind, be curious, and ask your partner for the three things worth knowing.

nf16e03.title: A kind no is still a no.
nf16e03.caption: Saying no to family is hard when you love them. Start with what you can say yes to, then say the limit clearly. Warm and clear can go together.

nf16e04.title: Their family does it differently.
nf16e04.caption: Their family does things differently than yours, and that can feel strange at first. Different isn't wrong. Ask about the why and you'll learn who they are.

nf16e05.title: The question you're not ready for.
nf16e05.caption: The question you're not ready for always seems to come at the table. You don't owe anyone a timeline. A warm, honest answer is enough. Save this for dinner.

nf16e06.title: The first five minutes at the door.
nf16e06.caption: Nervous about the first five minutes at the door? Skip the script. Ask one real question, then really listen.

nf16e07.title: Don't leave them alone at the party.
nf16e07.caption: You brought them to the party, so stay close. A glance, a squeeze or a quiet "you good?" helps someone new feel at home.

nf16e08.title: Give them a heads-up, not a warning.
nf16e08.caption: Worried your family will be a lot? A short, honest heads-up is a kindness. Say what to expect without apologizing for your people, then trust them.

nf16e09.title: Two families, one holiday.
nf16e09.caption: When both families want the same day, it's easy to feel pulled in half. You're on the same team. Choose together, then tell both families together.

nf16e10.title: What do I bring to their parents?
nf16e10.caption: Stressing over what to bring their parents? The best gift isn't the biggest one. Ask your partner what they love and bring something that shows you listened.

nf16e11.title: When the family takes a while to warm up.
nf16e11.caption: Some families take a while to warm up to someone new. That isn't a verdict. Give it time, stand beside your partner, and keep the bigger talks private.

nf16e12.title: They're not ready to meet my family.
nf16e12.caption: Hearing "not yet" about meeting your family can sting. Not yet isn't never. Get curious instead of hurt, and ask what would make it easier.
